title: Lp Reviewer Optimize Output
description: Output of the *optimize task (Hawk). Conversion optimization plan plus the final ship verdict.

optimizationPlan.description: optimization-plan.md — improvements prioritized by impact x effort: Quick Wins (do now), Strategic Improvements (plan), and A/B test suggestions (headline, CTA, form placement, social proof) each with a hypothesis.

finalVerdict.description: Final ship decision derived from the review verdict: SHIP only when 0 critical and <= 2 major issues remain; otherwise NO_SHIP and the page returns to the responsible agent for fixes before shipping.
